title: 4D Construction Scheduling — Duplex
description: Drive the Duplex through a synthetic 24-week construction schedule using SchedulePlayer. Each task is bound to a slice of the model's SceneObjects (foundations, ground-floor slab, ground-floor walls, first-floor walls + slab, roof, interior fit-out), and the player transitions each slice through Pending → InProgress → Complete by writing per-object state to data textures — so a per-frame state apply across hundreds of objects costs no geometry rebuild. Scrub the timeline or hit Play to watch the building assemble itself; the camera flies to each milestone's AABB as the cursor crosses it.
